title: Senior Fund Operations Manager
description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. As we scale following our Series B, we are looking for a Senior Fund Operations Manager to play a key role in delivering exceptional fund operations and service quality to our customers. This is not a traditional fund administration role focused on repetitive processing. We are looking for operators who deeply understand private markets operations, enjoy solving complexity, and want to help shape how modern fund administration should work. You will work at the intersection of fund operations, client service, and product development - partnering closely with fund managers, investors, product teams, and internal operations functions to deliver a seamless experience across the full fund lifecycle. We are particularly looking for strong expertise in fund administration, transfer agency operations, fund onboarding, and complex post-close operational processes. Your role Act as a strategic operational partner to fund managers, supporting them across the day-to-day operations of their funds and delivering an exceptional customer experience. Own and coordinate complex post-close operational processes, including capital calls, distributions, investor reporting cycles, and ongoing fund lifecycle events. Lead operational execution for fund migrations and new fund launches, including the review, reconciliation, and migration of historical data from previous administrators. Own capital call and distribution calculations end-to-end using our automated operational workflows, including the interpretation of LPA clauses, management fee calculations, equalisation mechanics, liquidity buffer assessments, and investor allocation logic. Partner directly with fund managers to explain methodologies, align on assumptions and outputs, incorporate feedback where appropriate, and guide clients towards operationally and legally sound approaches based on fund documentation. Partner with Fund Accounting to support recurring reporting cycles and ensure operational and financial data is complete, accurate, and audit-ready. Support treasury-related workflows, including payment coordination, invoice handling, and operational cash movement processes. Act as a key point of contact for fund managers and investors, helping resolve operational queries with a high level of responsiveness and ownership. Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to shape and improve our internal platform and operational tooling based on real customer workflows and operational pain points. Help drive the evolution of our “full back-office” operating model by identifying opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and scalable operational design. Support, review, and mentor more junior team members, helping establish high standards for quality, operational rigour, and client service. Improve processes, workflows, and documentation across the organisation to increase scalability, transparency, and operational excellence. About you You bring 4+ years of experience in fund administration, fund operations, transfer agency, or related private markets operations environments. You have strong hands-on experience managing operational fund workflows across the full lifecycle, particularly capital activity, reporting processes, and complex operational coordination. You understand private markets fund structures and are comfortable reviewing LPAs, investment agreements, and related fund documentation to identify operationally relevant terms and requirements. You are highly detail-oriented and able to manage complex operational processes with accuracy and ownership under tight timelines. You are comfortable working cross-functionally with other Fund Accounting, Product, and client-facing teams. You bring a strong service mindset and understand how operational quality directly impacts customer trust and long-term relationships. You enjoy improving systems and processes and are excited by the opportunity to help modernise fund administration through technology and AI. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You enjoy mentoring others and raising the operational quality bar across a team. You are fluent in English; German is a plus. Workplace & Benefits Competitive salary Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more) 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office) Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains Hiring Process People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit Hiring Manager Interview (45 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and culture Case interview (45 min) + VP of Ops screen (30 min) – Collaborative problem-solving and communication skills Final Round (60 min) – Meet our Founders and senior stakeholders Reference calls to confirm your relationship building abilities About bunch bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management. We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it. ____ At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants. We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Commercial Finance Manager
description: About Us Avenir Collective. Building the future of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands. We acquire and scale high-potential consumer brands, bringing together the capital, people and operating expertise to turn strong brands into enduring businesses. Your role at a Glance As a Senior Commercial Finance Manager in our Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting the Group Finance Director and wider leadership team by delivering accurate, timely and insightful financial reporting. Your main focus will be leading the preparation of Group reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring financial information is clear, meaningful and supports better business decisions through close collaboration with stakeholders across the organisation. This role is ideal for someone with strong commercial finance expertise and a proactive, analytical mindset , who enjoys working closely with senior stakeholders and using financial insight to influence business performance. Your work will directly impact how we understand our performance, manage costs and identify opportunities for growth across the business. Location & Flexibility Full-time, permanent role based at our modern office in Holborn, London Working Hours: 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the London office at least 2 or 3 days per week Key responsibilities Group Reporting • Prepare the Group's monthly management reporting. • Produce reporting for the Executive Leadership Team and Board. • Analyse revenue, gross margin, operating costs and EBITDA. • Prepare clear commentary explaining business performance, key movements, risks and opportunities. • Investigate queries from the Group Finance Director and senior leaders, providing clear answers and recommendations. • Continue to improve reporting, KPIs and dashboards. Budgeting and Forecasting • Support the forecasting process. • Support the annual budget process. • Prepare financial models and scenario analysis. • Monitor performance against budget and forecast, explaining key variances. • Highlight risks and opportunities early. OPEX Reporting • Prepare the Group's operating expense reporting. • Work closely with budget holders to review monthly spend. • Lead regular meetings with budget holders to review performance and forecasts. • Prepare monthly operating expense forecasts. • Investigate and explain significant variances. • Identify opportunities to improve cost control and reporting. Business Partnering • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business. • Provide financial support and challenge where needed. • Help managers understand their financial performance. • Support business cases and commercial decisions with clear financial analysis. Month End • Work with the Financial Control team to ensure accurate month-end reporting. • Prepare monthly variance analysis and supporting commentary. • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting as required. Continuous Improvement • Improve reporting, forecasting and planning processes. • Look for opportunities to automate and simplify reporting. • Help improve the quality and consistency of financial information. About you ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified with strong experience in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Finance Business Partnering roles. Proven experience preparing management reporting, budgets, forecasts and financial models in a commercial environment. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information and translate it into actionable insights. Confident communicator with experience partnering with senior stakeholders and explaining financial concepts to non-finance teams. Advanced Excel skills, with experience using financial systems such as NetSuite and reporting tools such as Power BI desirable. Experience working within consumer products, retail, e-commerce or another fast-paced, high-growth environment. What Success Looks Like Within your first six months you will: Produce accurate and reliable Group reporting. Deliver high-quality budgets and forecasts. Build strong relationships with budget holders. Become the first point of contact for commercial finance reporting and analysis. Improve the quality and efficiency of reporting. Provide clear answers and insight that support better business decisions. Perks & Benefits Salary: £75,000 to £85,000 per year 30 days holiday + 8 UK bank holidays Pension contribution Scheme – 5% from you, 3% from us. Private Medical Insurance – Includes travel, vision & dental (Vitality) Work from Abroad – One month per year, anywhere in the world Bonus Scheme – Discretionary bonus, based on individual and company performance Mental Health Support – Free, confidential therapy via Spill Opportunity for International Travel – Our team members have been to New York, Vegas, Amsterdam… and Birmingham! Flexi-Fridays – Finish early one Friday per month Olstar Events – Quarterly meetups, celebrations & socials Vibrant Office – Runway East, Bloomsbury Avenir Collective is proud to be a disability-committed employer registered in the UK. If you identify as having a disability and meet all of the criteria set out in the job description, we would like to support you through the interview stage. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish. title: Marketing Analytics & Attribution Manager – FX & CFDs
description: ThinkMarkets is a global financial technology company, specializing in providing multi-asset trading solutions to thousands of clients around the world. With our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we make it available for our clients to trade the world 24-hours a day. Our mission is to bridge the gap between traders, investors, and platforms by allowing access to global markets and thousands of products thus providing our clients the ability to trade the world in the palm of their hand. We use the latest technologies to give traders seamless access to our proprietary trading platforms. We are seeking a Marketing Analytics and Technology Manager to oversee the implementation and optimization of marketing technology solutions, data analysis, and revenue attribution. The role focuses on accurately measuring revenue generated from various marketing efforts and optimizing these channels for enhanced performance. The successful candidate will collaborate with marketing, finance, and product teams to gather actionable insights and develop strategies that enhance overall business outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Data Analysis and Insights: Collect and analyze marketing data from various channels (paid media, social media, email, etc.) to evaluate campaign performance and customer behavior. Provide insights on key metrics such as return on investment (ROI), customer acquisition costs, and lifetime value. Revenue Tracking and Attribution: Develop and maintain models for accurate revenue attribution across marketing touchpoints. Ensure proper tracking of user journeys, conversions, and revenue through analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel). Analytics and Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards to report on key performance indicators (KPIs), conversion rates, and ROI. Prepare regular reports on marketing performance, revenue contributions, and actionable insights, and present them to senior management. Data Layers and Technology Integration: Develop and manage data layers for analytics tools like Google Tag Manager, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Configure and integrate marketing technology tools (e.g., CRM, email platforms, analytics systems) to ensure seamless data flow and accurate reporting. Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing, sales, IT, and finance teams to optimize marketing technology systems, improve tracking accuracy, and drive overall business performance. Partner with finance teams to reconcile marketing expenses and revenue contributions. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in marketing, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field is required. 5 years of experience in data analysis, marketing technology, or revenue attribution would be ideal. Expertise in marketing attribution models and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and Google Tag Manager. Experience with marketing technology integrations (e.g., CRM, email, and analytics platforms) and data management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to deliver actionable insights and optimize marketing efforts. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings to senior management and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role This is a commercially focused GTM Operations role supporting Heidi’s UK and European markets. You’ll report to the Head of GTM Operations and work closely with leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Finance, as well as our central Analytics and GTM Engineering teams. Your job is to turn commercial direction into an operating model the region can actually use. When leaders agree how we should forecast, segment accounts, organise territories or manage the customer lifecycle, you’ll build the models, processes, reporting and tooling that make it work day to day. Doing that well means working beyond the CRM. You’ll use HubSpot, Databricks and Omni to bring together commercial and product data, pressure-test assumptions and turn what you find into better decisions and processes. This role suits someone who enjoys both sides of GTM Operations: working through commercial problems with leaders, then doing the hands-on work to make the solution stick. What you’ll do Turn commercial plans into working operations. Partner with the Head of GTM Operations and regional leaders to operationalise decisions on segmentation, territories, coverage, capacity, quotas and commissions. Build the models, processes and operating cadences that allow teams to execute them consistently. Connect the full customer lifecycle. Build and improve the processes between Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, from lead management and pipeline creation through onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion. Improve how we inspect pipeline, forecast revenue and understand customer health, retention and growth. Use data to support commercial decisions. Query existing datasets in Databricks, build reporting in Omni and connect CRM, product and commercial data to understand performance. Maintain HubSpot and the regional GTM stack, including pipelines, routing, workflows, reporting and data quality. We care more about the ownership and judgement you’ve developed than a fixed number of years. Strong commercial judgement. You can reason across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, understand the drivers of acquisition, conversion, adoption, retention and expansion, and distinguish an interesting data point from something the business should act on. Confident with data. You can write SQL, navigate a warehouse such as Databricks and work with a BI tool such as Omni. You’re comfortable interrogating existing datasets, validating the output and turning the result into a clear recommendation. Experience building core warehouse models is not required. A strong, credible operator. You can take an agreed commercial approach and turn it into a workable model, process or system change. You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions with evidence, bring the right people with you and follow through until the change is adopted. A practical, tool-fluent systems thinker. You understand how process, data, tooling and team behaviour interact. You’re confident in HubSpot and have worked with tools such as Clay, Gong, outbound platforms, enrichment providers and CPQ/CLM systems, or can get productive in them quickly. How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford. Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander. Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless. Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi? You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. True A-players progress extremely fast here. description: <p>Optiver is looking for a Senior Digital Assets Software Engineer to join our Digital Assets Tech Team in London. In this role, you’ll build and evolve trading systems for cryptocurrency markets, working closely with traders and researchers to deliver solutions in a fast-moving and constantly changing environment.</p> <p>You’ll play a key role in building out our digital assets platform, helping shape both the technology and engineering practices from the ground up. You’ll work side-by-side with traders and researchers, iterating quickly on ideas and translating market insights into production systems. From integrating with major centralised exchanges to improving system reliability in real-world conditions, your work will directly impact how we trade in this rapidly growing space.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build trading systems for digital asset markets</li> <li>Develop and manage connectivity to centralised exchanges such as Binance, Deribit, and OKX</li> <li>Work directly with traders and researchers to prototype and iterate on trading strategies</li> <li>Improve system reliability through automation, monitoring, and robust recovery mechanisms</li> <li>Troubleshoot issues across trading systems and exchange integrations</li> <li>Contribute to architecture and help shape the digital assets platform</li> <li>Take ownership of production systems and drive continuous improvements</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally in trading, crypto, or other real-time systems</li> <li>Strong C++ development skills, with experience building reliable production systems</li> <li>Hands-on experience integrating with centralised cryptocurrency exchanges (e.g., Binance, Deribit, OKX)</li> <li>Experience working with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, or similar) is a plus</li> <li>Good understanding of distributed systems, networking, and failure handling</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Comfortable working in a highly collaborative environment, partnering directly with traders and researchers</li> <li>Able to translate ambiguous trading requirements into practical engineering solutions</li> <li>Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on building resilient systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are </strong></p> <p>At Optiver, our mission is to continuously improve the market. title: Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start)
description: <p>If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Your onboarding </strong></p> <p>You’ll participate in <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONPObMHh-k8">Global Optiver Academy</a>, a structured onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business. </p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities </strong></p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:</p> <ul> <li>Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.</li> <li>Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.</li> <li>Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.</li> <li>Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.</li> <li>Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <p>We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. </p> <p>In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:</p> <ul> <li>An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements</li> <li>Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)</li> <li>Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra</li> <li>Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written English language skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.</p> <p>In addition, you’ll receive:</p> <ul> <li>A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool</li> <li>The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries</li> <li>25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards</li> <li>Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses</li> <li>Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more</li> <li>Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events</li> <li>Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats</li> </ul> <p><strong>HOW TO APPLY</strong></p> <p>Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?</p> <p>Apply directly via the form below for the position of Graduate Quantitative Researcher. Please provide us with a CV in English.  Unfortunately we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons. </p> <p>If your application is selected to proceed to the next round, you will be required to complete online assessments. By submitting your application you are confirming that you will be able to take the assessment within 7 days.</p> <p>Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our <a href="https://optiver.com/contact-eu-recruitment/">recruitment inquiry form.</a></p> <p><strong>Diversity statement</strong></p> <p>Optiver is committed to <a href="https://optiver.com/diversity-statement/">diversity and inclusion</a>.</p> <p>We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. You will be accountable for the strategy, commercial performance, investment decisions and long-term growth of a network that serves some of the world's most sophisticated financial institutions.</p> <p>You will operate as the business owner for euTrade, with direct responsibility for its P&L and the freedom to shape its future direction. Your decisions will dictate where we invest, which routes we build, how we compete and how we maintain our leadership position in one of the most demanding and competitive markets in telecommunications.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, accountability, uncovering opportunities before competitors do and building defensible advantages. While an interest in networks and financial markets is helpful, we place far greater value on commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity, strategic thinking and execution.</p> <p>If you've read <em>Flash Boys</em> by Michael Lewis, or you’ve watched <em>The Hummingbird Project</em> and found yourself fascinated by the commercial value of latency, the race to build faster routes and the strategic importance of infrastructure, this role offers the opportunity to shape and grow one of the industry's leading ultra-low-latency platforms.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What will you be doing?</strong></p> <p><strong>Own the Business</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the project management and product P&L, including revenue growth, profitability and cost leadership</li> <li>Build business cases and evaluate investment opportunities</li> <li>Define pricing strategy and support sales drive return on investment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Understand the Market Better Than Anyone Else</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a deep understanding of exchange growth, liquidity shifts, mergers, acquisitions and venue migrations</li> <li>Understand trading firm and market data provider business models, points-of-presence, and the value of latency within their ecosystems</li> <li>Analyse competitor strategies, strengths, network developments and customer loyalty dynamics</li> effective investment and go-to-market decisions</li> <li>Assess risks, scenarios and potential responses before committing resources, adapting strategies as market conditions evolve</li> <li>Use data, market intelligence and commercial insight to guide decision-making and strengthen competitive advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead the Product Lifecycle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define product strategy and long-term roadmap</li> <li>Manage lifecycle decisions across the portfolio</li> <li>Support new logo acquisition, cross-sell and upsell campaigns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build Relationships Across the Ecosystem and combined with market Intelligent </strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop strategic relationships with customers, partners and industry stakeholders</li> <li>Influence decision-makers and build credibility across the market</li> <li>Negotiate commercial agreements and partnership opportunities</li> <li>Support Sales in customer engagements and product positioning.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What do we want from you?</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial Instinct</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and an ownership mindset</li> <li>Experience evaluating opportunities, investments and business cases</li> <li>Ability to balance growth, profitability and strategic positioning</li> <li>Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information</li> </ul> <p><strong>Exceptional Problem Solving Ability</strong></p> <ul> <li>A structured and analytical approach to complex challenges</li> <li>Outstanding attention to detail especially during planning</li> <li>Ability to assess options, risks and competitive responses</li> <li>Natural curiosity and a desire to understand how markets really work</li> <li>Interest in strategy, incentives, game theory and competitive dynamics</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shrewd Tactical Thinking</strong></p> <ul> <li>You enjoy competition and finding ways to win</li> <li>You anticipate competitor actions and position accordingly</li> <li>You understand how small advantages can compound into meaningful market leadership</li> <li>You are constantly looking for opportunities to create sustainable differentiation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Self-Motivation and Drive</strong></p> <ul> <li>A go-getter mentality with a bias towards execution</li> <li>Comfortable working autonomously and <p><strong>Relationship Building and Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong stakeholder management and communication skills</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers, partners and internal Curiosity</strong></p> <ul> <li>A base level of technical literacy in networking, DWDM and optical infrastructure is desirable, but most important is the willingness and capacity to learn quickly</li> and support to enable you to develop in the role.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About Us</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":280}"> </span></p> <p>SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. <strong>Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja</strong>, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Manager, Media Analytics - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people's lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market, and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 3,300+ associates, the company's products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.</p> <p>We don't just make products. We identify and solve customer problems, some that customers don't even know they have. We tell that story via social, digital, broadcast, print, and retail media across organic, paid, influencer, and earned channels.</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a Manager, Media Analytics to lead predictive measurement of our media investments across channels—building forward-looking models that anticipate performance, uncover insights, and fuel smarter, faster decisions.</p> <p>This role will join a growing Global Marketing Analytics Team, transforming data into clear actions that optimize marketing performance and guide media, social, and creative strategies. The ideal candidate will thrive in SharkNinja's fast-moving culture — balancing rigor with pragmatism and using predictive data not only to measure performance but to influence decisions and spark the next opportunity.</p> <p>This role is based in London, UK and sits within our EMEA Marketing Analytics team, with primary responsibility for the UK market. While primarily supporting the UK, the role also provides analytical support to the Nordics and other emerging European markets as needed.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Predictive Modelling: </strong>Build and maintain predictive and forecasting models—spanning MMM, attribution, and incrementality—to anticipate media performance and guide allocation decisions before results are final.</li> <li><strong>KPI Measurement: </strong>Own the metrics that matter, ensuring media activity is measured against clear goals and forecasted with increasing precision over time, and that agency partners are held accountable against these benchmarks through robust governance and performance management.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Channel Optimization: </strong>Partner with internal teams and agencies to pivot strategies based on real-time insights and forward-looking model outputs.</li> <li><strong>Audience and Creative Effectiveness: </strong>Partner with internal teams and agencies to analyse audience and creative effectiveness across SharkNinja's product categories, leading with data-informed insights.</li> <li><strong>Brand & Talent Evaluation: </strong>Monitor and report out on brand health and ambassador performance by analysing consumer sentiment data, ensuring celebrity investments align with SharkNinja's brand identity and drive measurable advertising lift.</li> <li><strong>Signal Detection: </strong>Proactively identify signals, anomalies, or emerging patterns in media and market data to flag risks or opportunities before they escalate.</li> <li><strong>Reporting & Dashboards: </strong>Build and maintain concise, audience-appropriate dashboards that highlight what's working, what isn't, and where predictive models point next. Collaborate with Data & Engineering teams to maintain the integrity of the media analytics ecosystem, where data quality is validated, and dashboards provide accurate, actionable insights.</li> <li><strong>Insights to Action: </strong>Translate complex, model-driven data into compelling stories that lead to concrete recommendations and immediate adjustments.</li> <li><strong>Team & Stakeholder Partnership: </strong>Mentor junior analysts and partner closely with regional marketing, brand, performance and agency stakeholders to embed predictive thinking into day-to-day media decisions.</li> <li><strong>Market Ownership: </strong>Act as the primary analytics partner for the UK market, tailoring measurement frameworks, KPIs, and recommendations to reflect the UK's stage of market maturity, while extending analytical support to the Nordics and other emerging markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Attributes & Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.</li> <li>6+ years of experience in marketing analytics within a consumer-driven industry, with direct experience building or applying predictive/forecasting models.</li> <li>Strong grasp of both digital performance channels and traditional media measurement.</li> <li>Commercially curious mindset that goes beyond the numbers, to understand marketing effectiveness and commercial outcomes. Constantly asks “so what?” and “what should we do differently?” to influence better business decisions.</li> <li>Experience delivering analytics across emerging, growth, and mature markets, with the ability to tailor measurement frameworks, KPIs, benchmarks, and recommendations to reflect the different objectives and stages of market maturity.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with MMM, attribution, or incrementality methodologies.</li> <li>Familiarity with building in AI tools such as Claude.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with agencies and cross-functional teams to act on insights quickly.</li> <li>Ability to simplify complexity, focusing on insights that drive business impact.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills to influence decision-makers at all levels.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, agile environment with shifting priorities.</li> <li>For this London-based role, familiarity with additional European languages (e.g. Nordic languages) is a plus, given occasional coverage of the Nordics.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Our Culture</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"> drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Learn more about us:</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span> <br><a href="https://sharkninja.com/dei"> </a><a href="https://www.instagram.com/sharkninja/"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Life At SharkNinja</span></span></a>  <br><a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLmRfBxyGu_mKl9SF12lM1NAIx-z07uLNQ"><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Outrageously Extraordinary</span></span></strong></a><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":120,"335559739":120,"335559740":336}"> </span></p> </div> <div> <p data-start="88" data-end="129"><strong data-start="88" data-end="127">SharkNinja Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <ul data-start="131" data-end="402"> <li data-start="131" data-end="224"> <p data-start="133" data-end="224">For candidates based in <strong data-start="157" data-end="172">all regions</strong>, please refer to this <a href="https://www.sharkninja.com/candidate-privacy-notice.html">Candidate Privacy Notic

description: <h2><strong>About The Role</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Role Overview</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a project specific <strong>Project Director</strong> for a multi-project initiative that creates cutting-edge 3D visualization workflows supporting marketing and media production for a new urban city. the creative and strategic direction of the project(s) or programmes in their remit. This role leads the full design and delivery teams, owns the client relationship at a strategic level, sets the overall vision and is accountable for the quality of what we produce and how it speaks to the client’s requirements.</p> <p>This role is not programme responsible. Every Project Director is paired with a Lead Producer or Programme PM who owns the programme plan, budget and delivery. The Project Director is the creative and strategic counterpart to that delivery lead, and the two share accountability for the overall health of the project. In addition a technical director will be assigned, who is accountable for the proper design and delivery of the technical aspects of the programme. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:</p> <h4><strong>Vision, creative and quality</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Sets the early-stage concept and approach, shaping the project with the client and team against the agreed contractual scope and realistic delivery requirements.</li> <li>Holds the overall vision from pitch through to launch and keeps the work coherent as the project evolves.</li> <li>Oversees quality, technical and creative objectives, making sure client goals are met within the budget and schedule</li> <li>Leads regular reviews, balancing client objectives with commercial reality.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Client strategy and stakeholder management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Owns the senior client relationship on strategy and quality </li> <li>Builds a working knowledge of the client's business and translates their goals into a project vision the team can build against. </li> <li>Leads senior stakeholder communication on creative and strategic matters, and is the escalation point when a client has concerns about the work itself. For Mega App this means. Digital twins, CMS systems, Web front and back end.</li> <li>Can hold a credible conversation with engineering leads, and with the client, about technical trade-offs that affect the creative ambition.</li> <li>Does not need to be hands-on. Needs enough fluency to make informed calls and to know when to bring in a technical lead.</li> <li>Keeps current with creative technology and brings relevant developments into project and pitch thinking.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Working with delivery</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Paired with a Lead Producer or Programme PM who owns the programme plan, budget, resourcing and margin. </li> <li>Also teamed with a Technical Director who owns the technical architecture, advises on approach and communicates back to the technical team on scope </li> <li>Contributes to scoping and estimating: shapes what is being proposed and its level of ambition so estimates reflect what will actually get built.</li> <li>Raises changes in scope or ambition early, and works through the trade-offs with the delivery lead rather than presenting them as decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works closely with the allocated Account Director to maximise opportunities within this client and the wider client ecosystem</li> <li>Ensures they are managing and billing incremental work scope or making decisions to zero change order based on client relationship and value </li> </ul> <p><strong>HR</strong></p> <ul> <li>Line management of project team members, indirect management of adjacent departments or disciplines as it relates to the project</li> <li>Leads performance reviews </li> <li>Ensures continued professional development / training of staff in their team</li> <li>Participates in the interview and selection process for all project team members alongside the Lead Producer </li> <li>Serve as a role model and mentor within the project and externally; participate in knowledge shares and actively improve process</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Candidate Qualifications & Skills</strong></h3> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>A track record of leading creative direction on complex digital projects, ideally including apps or product-style builds rather than campaign work alone.</li> <li>Comfortable owning senior client relationships and presenting to exec-level stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience working with technical fluency relevant to this project: Digital Twins, CMS systems, Web Front and Web Backend.</li> <li>Experience line managing and growing a team.</li> <li>Communicates a clear sense of direction and purpose for the team, in person and in writing.</li> <li>Clear experience adapting well to changing priorities.</li> <li>Remaining up to date on industry trends and developments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Contract Type: </strong>Fixed Term Contract - 12 Months </p> <p><strong>Location :</strong> London</p> <p>We value regular in-person collaboration because we think it leads to the best creative work however hybrid working is available around project commitments.</p> <p><strong>Application: </strong>Please submit a CV demonstrating your experience along with a bespoke cover letter explaining how your experience meets the required and desirable criteria of this role.</p> <p><strong>Interviews:</strong> Introductory calls and interviews are anticipated from 14th September. We aim to run two rounds of interview for this role with various members of our project teams, time to visit the studio and opportunity to meet more people in person.</p> <p>If you have any questions about accessibility in applying for this position please highlight this in your cover letter.</p> <p>We follow pay transparency, meaning we publish a salary range for each role. title: Senior Brand Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="mt4"> <p>Grey’s mission is to create Famously Effective ideas that move people, businesses, and the world forward, harnessing the power of creativity to solve business challenges and drive growth for some of the world’s most influential brands and companies, including Procter & Gamble, Volvo, Haleon, Circle K, and The Coca-Cola Company. That commitment to effectiveness has earned Grey a Grand Effie in every market where it operates. Grey was recognized as a 2025 Fast Company World Changing Ideas winner and earned 26 Lions at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, contributing to Ogilvy’s Network of the Year honors. Newsweek also named Grey a Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace in 2024 and one of America's Greatest Workplaces for Women and Professional Services in 2025. Grey is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> </div></div><p></p> <div> <p><strong>Shape the brands that shape health.</strong> <br><br>At Grey Health, we believe health brands deserve the same ambition, creativity and cultural relevance as the world's most iconic consumer brands.</p> <p>We're looking for a <strong>Senior Brand Strategist</strong> who is endlessly curious about people, behaviour and culture. Someone who loves untangling complex challenges, finding unexpected opportunities and turning insights into ideas that make a genuine impact.</p> <p>This is a chance to work at the intersection of strategy, creativity, science and culture, helping to build brands that don't just communicate healthcare, but make it matter. You'll partner with some of the industry's most talented creatives, medical experts and client leaders to create work that changes perceptions, influences behaviour and delivers business results.<br></p> <div> <p>As a Senior Brand Strategist, you'll play a key role in developing insight-led brand and communications strategies for healthcare, wellness and pharmaceutical clients.From uncovering audience insights and market opportunities to shaping creative platforms and client narratives, you'll help turn complexity into clarity and create ideas that inspire action.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who combines analytical thinking with creative imagination and enjoys moving seamlessly between research, strategy, storytelling and collaboration.</p> </div> </div> <p> </p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Develop insight-led brand, positioning and communications strategies.Identify human, cultural and category insights that unlock growth opportunities.</li> <li>Translate complex healthcare and scientific challenges into clear strategic narratives.</li> <li>Write inspiring creative briefs that spark outstanding creative work.</li> <li>Partner closely with creative, medical, engagement and client teams throughout the development process.</li> <li>Design and facilitate workshops, stakeholder sessions and strategic planning discussions.</li> <li>Present recommendations confidently and help shape client thinking.</li> <li>Bring fresh perspectives, new provocations and innovative approaches to every project.</li> <li>Take ownership of strategic workstreams and help drive projects forward with energy and initiative.<br><br></li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED:</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Experience developing brand and communications strategies within healthcare, pharma or wellness.</li> <li>Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, audience insight and brand growth principles.</li> <li>Experience building strategies from insight through to activation.</li> <li>Exceptional storytelling, presentation and communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to simplify complex information and identify opportunities others might miss.</li> <li>Experience contributing to workshops, stakeholder engagement and collaborative problem-solving sessions.</li> <li>A balance of analytical rigour and creative thinking.</li> <li>A proactive mindset with a genuine passion for learning and growth.</li> </ul> </div> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE:</strong><strong>      </strong></p> <p></p> <div> <p>You're someone who:</p> <ul> <li>Is naturally curious and always asking better questions.</li> <li>Loves understanding how people think, feel and behave.</li> <li>Thrives on solving complex problems.</li> <li>Is comfortable with ambiguity and enjoys exploring new territory.</li> <li>Brings energy, positivity and collaboration to every interaction.</li> <li>Is ambitious about the work, but humble in how you approach it.</li> <li>Enjoys challenging conventional thinking and pushing ideas further.</li> <li>Wants to create work that has a meaningful impact on people's lives.</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">What can you expect from us?</span></strong> <br><span data-contrast="none">At Grey, you’ll have the opportunity to work at an incredible studio, with some of the most creative and inspired people in the industry, all whilst getting to grow & shape your career with us. We offer a competitive salary, lots of training, plenty of benefits and wellbeing perks too.</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Inclusion & Belonging</span></strong> <br><span data-contrast="none">At Grey, we know that the more diverse the input, the more famous and effective the output. architectures.</p> <p>In addition to hands-on configuration and technical execution, you will serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, guiding cross-functional delivery teams and ensuring <li>Translating complex client requirements into scalable technical specifications, architecture blueprints, and data models.</li> <li>Establishing quality assurance and testing standards to guarantee the reliability of complex configurations, custom code, and new platform features.</li> <li>Serving as a primary point of technical escalation to troubleshoot and resolve high-level application issues across SFMC environments.</li> <li>Leading requirements-gathering workshops with senior client marketers to translate business objectives into advanced technical solutions.</li> <li>Managing complex data architecture, SQL queries, and audience segmentation while ensuring data integrity, governance, and security.</li> <li>Mentoring and upskilling junior Application Consultants and Specialists, fostering technical excellence across the team.</li> <li>Proactively identifying opportunities to enhance and optimize the Catalyst platform and its features for enterprise clients.</li> </ul> <h2>Who are you going to work with?</h2> <p>You will join a senior team of developers, technical architects, data specialists, product managers, and project managers who are passionate about building enterprise products and customer experiences. You will also work closely with Client Partners, Solutions Architects, and client C-suite/technical leadership.</p> <h2>What do you bring to the table?</h2> <p>As a person, you are a strategic leader, an empathetic mentor, and an influential communicator who can confidently articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You possess an open-minded, solution-oriented attitude that thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You analyse problems pragmatically and take a big-picture consulting approach, actively advising clients and internal teams on technical best practices.</p> <p>In addition, you have:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) across Journey Builder, Automation Studio, AMPscript, SSJS, and custom API integrations.</li> <li>Deep, proven expertise in Marketing Operations, including advanced marketing automation setups and enterprise lifecycle marketing frameworks.</li> <li>Extensive track record of designing, building, and optimizing complex, multi-channel customer journeys and trigger-based marketing programs.</li> <li>Advanced client-facing consultancy skills, with proven ability to lead technical workshops, manage executive expectations, and adapt to diverse client ways of working.</li> <li>Strong technical proficiency in JavaScript, SSJS, AMPscript, and HTML/CSS for building custom solutions inside marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Advanced data management expertise, including complex SQL querying, audience segmentation, data validation, and governance.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience acting as a technical lead, mentoring junior team members, and driving quality standards across projects.</li> </ul> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, and CRM. title: Implementation Manager (UK)
description: About Bobyard Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast. About the role You own the first 45 days of every new customer, from signed contract to a live, trained, adopting account. Launch quality can't depend on whichever CSM picks it up, so this role runs one repeatable process. You win when customers launch fast and the CSM who inherits the account never has to ask what happened. This seat is remote in the UK, works UK hours alongside our San Francisco team, and supports our largest customers in the region. What you'll do Turn every AE/SE handoff into a confirmed launch plan within 48 hours of signature Configure accounts and run kickoff and hands-on training that gets crews using Bobyard on real jobs Drive customers to their first completed workflow and adoption milestone inside 45 days Run reinforcement sessions and office hours that catch stragglers before they churn Chase blockers with CS and Product until they're resolved, not just logged Hand off to the CSM with every exit criterion closed and the account documented What we're looking for 2+ years owning SaaS onboarding or implementation across a real portfolio of accounts Hands-on comfort configuring software yourself You've run live training for non-technical or field-based users A track record against a launch or time-to-value SLA, and you know your numbers Sharp, structured written communication Comfortable owning 10+ concurrent launches with little day-to-day oversight Nice to have Vertical SaaS or construction tech experience CRM or onboarding tooling (Salesforce, Asana, Notion) Built an onboarding playbook from scratch Bilingual (Spanish or otherwise) What we offer Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do. £70,000–£90,000 base (£110,000+ OTE) + equity Occasional trips to our San Francisco HQ Full-time, remote in the UK. Comp Philosophy Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver. title: Associate Director,  People Strategy & Execution
description: Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution About us: We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. Role Purpose Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team, the Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution plays a central role in shaping how the function operates and delivers. They turn ClearBank’s People strategy into a focused plan and drive delivery through the People Leadership Team and programme owners. They connect priorities, programmes, budgets and governance - creating clarity, strengthening accountability and ensuring decisions lead to action and measurable outcomes. The role gives a clear view of progress, risks and investment choices, while coordinating high-quality reporting for Group ExCo, Board and TopCo. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad exposure across ClearBank. When priorities stall or complex challenges arise, they step in to unblock progress, bring structure and pace, and lead critical programmes that matter to the business Key Responsibilities Own the People strategy and roadmap, partnering with the Group Chief People Officer and People Leadership Team to translate business priorities into clear outcomes, choices and plans. Drive execution of the People roadmap through People leaders and programme owners, maintaining oversight of progress, outcomes, risks and dependencies; providing constructive challenge; resolving cross-functional blockers; and escalating issues and decisions to keep delivery on track. Lead executive and Board reporting, producing clear, commercially focused insight and recommendations for Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums. Lead selected high-priority People initiatives, bringing structure, pace and stakeholder alignment to complex work requiring additional focus or acceleration. Own People Team operations and governance, running effective forums, agendas, decisions, actions and escalations, and ensuring clear ownership and follow-through. Own the People budget and Finance partnership, overseeing planning, forecasting, expenditure and investment choices to align resources with priorities and optimise costs. Build portfolio and programme capability across the People function, putting in place proportionate standards, tools and ways of working that improve delivery, alongside clear management information on outcomes, costs, risks, dependencies, capacity and decisions required. Improve how the People function operates, using clearer standards, simpler processes, data, digital tools and AI to strengthen consistency, insight and effectiveness. What success looks like in the role: The People strategy is clearly articulated, understood and translated into a prioritised roadmap with ClearBank’s People strategy is translated into action and delivers measurable outcomes. The Group Chief People Officer has a clear, reliable view of what is being delivered, by when, and where progress is at risk. The People Leadership Team is aligned around the roadmap, decisions, ownership and delivery expectations. Capacity constraints and competing demands are visible early, with clear recommendations on priorities, sequencing and trade-offs. Issues and dependencies are surfaced and resolved quickly, keeping critical work on track. The People function operates effectively and consistently, with proportionate governance, clear accountability and strong follow-through. The People function is represented credibly and commercially through high-quality reporting to Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums. Skills & Experience (must-have) Significant experience translating functional or business strategy into prioritised roadmaps and measurable outcomes. Strong programme or portfolio leadership experience , driving delivery through others using proportionate, adaptable approaches. Experience building effective governance and operating rhythms across senior leadership teams and complex portfolios. Excellent analytical, written and visual communication skills , turning complex information into concise, high-quality papers, presentations and recommendations for executive and Board audiences. Strong commercial and financial acumen , including budget ownership, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs. Credibility and influence with senior leaders , with the judgement to challenge constructively, align stakeholders and embed decisions without formal authority. A pragmatic, solutions-focused track record of simplifying complexity and improving execution , using proportionate standards, adaptable tools, data and AI to improve insight and delivery without unnecessary bureaucracy. Nice-to-have Working within, or in close partnership with, a People or HR function. Experience in banking, fintech, financial services or another regulated environment. Supporting Group ExCo, Board, or investor governance forums. Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities or a matrix organisational structure. Familiarity with OKRs or comparable strategy execution methodologies. Ways of Working & Culture Build trust together: Own outcomes end to end, follow through on commitments and create transparency around progress, risks and decisions. Care like we mean it: Consider the impact of strategic and operational decisions on colleagues, clients and the organisation, while providing direct and respectful challenge. Grow with the challenge: Remain resilient in a fast-moving environment, simplify complexity and use feedback and evidence to continually improve plans and delivery. Succeed as one: Engage stakeholders early, bring teams together around shared priorities and put organisation-wide outcomes ahead of functional boundaries. Clear a bold new path: Challenge legacy approaches, convert ideas into practical action and build governance and delivery solutions that can scale. If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply! *Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! Equal Opportunities ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. The legal bit By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: QA Engineer
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the Role We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our growing Product QA function and take ownership of testing across Artificial's product portfolio and customer specifications. This role covers both manual testing execution and hands-on automation work, moving flexibly between Platform and Transform (customer configuration) work as needed. Key Responsibilities Manual and automated testing execution: Own and execute both manual and automated test cases across Artificial's product suite and customer specifications - moving flexibly between Platform and Transform as priorities shift, and applying automation where it's the right fit and manual judgement where it isn't - including functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing, ensuring thorough coverage before releases reach production Test planning and design: Write clear, detailed test plans and test cases based on product requirements, acceptance criteria, and specification documents; identify edge cases and risk areas; ensure traceability between requirements and test coverage; maintain this as a growing knowledge base of product behaviour and testing approaches Customer specification testing: Test new and updated customer configurations and specifications to validate they meet requirements and behave correctly within the platform - reducing reliance on FDE for quality verification Automation contribution: Write and maintain automated tests within our established framework and standards, applying your existing automation experience rather than starting from scratch; help transition high-value manual test cases into automated coverage Bug identification and reporting: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity assessments, and supporting evidence in Linear; follow up with engineering teams to verify fixes and close the loop Regression testing: Execute regression test suites ahead of releases to catch unintended side effects; help maintain and expand the regression library as the product evolves Quality within DDO+ modes: Support QA touch points across Discovery (smoke-testing prototypes and early builds), Delivery (thorough testing of bets and features during development cycles), and Optimisation (validating bug fixes and investigating production issues) Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Solutions/FDEs to understand requirements, clarify expected behaviour, and ensure alignment on quality expectations for each release or specification About You 2-5 years of experience in a QA or software testing role, with a strong foundation in manual testing techniques Solid hands-on experience with at least one test automation framework (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) - comfortable both executing manual tests and maintaining automated ones Proven ability to write clear, structured test plans and test cases from requirements and specifications Experience with systematic testing approaches - functional, regression, integration, exploratory - and the judgement to know when each is appropriate Excellent bug reporting skills - you write reproduction steps that engineers can act on immediately Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g. Linear, Jira, or equivalent) A methodical, detail-oriented approach with strong analytical and problem-solving skills Comfortable working across multiple product areas and workstreams simultaneously Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance Life insurance of 4 * base salary On-site gym and shower facilities Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Team social events and company parties Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform Company stock options managed through Ledgy Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us! We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point. Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts. As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.
